notes: Canonical list of CoinCync public infrastructure endpoints.
Machine-readable so wallets, tooling, and docs pages can cross-reference
federation members without hardcoding URLs. Update on every host add/remove.

policy.add_mirror: A mirror may be added to explorer.mirrors or api.mirrors once its operator opens a PR against deploy/landing/mirrors.json with the URL, the IP it resolves to, the operator contact, and a verification transcript (curl against /get_info returning a chain tip consistent with the primary within 1 block). The PR is reviewed for basic sanity; the mirror is NOT trusted as a source of truth — each mirror is an independent observation that clients can cross-check.
policy.remove_mirror: A mirror is removed if it is offline for more than 72h, serves stale data (>1 block behind the primary for >10m), or the operator requests removal.
policy.trust_model: Every mirror runs its own independent cyncd node. Wallets and tooling that consume this file MUST treat each mirror as a separate observation. Agreement between 2+ mirrors strongly suggests the query result is correct; disagreement is a signal to query more mirrors or fall back to running your own node. There is no consensus authority in this file — it is a directory, not a source of truth.
